title: Cross-register reading lab
subtitle: Use one method for narrative, dialogue, proclamation, and epistle.
overview: B1 Bridge has introduced several New Testament registers. The same core method applies, but the reading questions change with the genre.
Narrative asks what happens; dialogue asks who responds; proclamation asks what is claimed; epistle asks how an argument is built.

sections.title: Genre-sensitive questions
rows: Mark finite events, setting, and response.
Mark address, claim, citation, and inference.
Find the assertion, grounds, phrases, and purpose.

items.grc: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν οἴκῳ.
items.en: And it happened while he was in a house.
What then shall we say to these things?
